name: Videos
description: Browse and watch the videos on your NAS: live folder browsing, ffmpeg thumbnails, resume positions, subtitles and TMDB metadata. The video API stays in EthOS so the Android Video app keeps working; this package ships the desktop app. Needs ffmpeg on the NAS for thumbnails and transcoding.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.2: renamed to Videos as part of the EthOS 2.0 product naming (ids and APIs unchanged). 1.0.1: light theme for the shell, rows and empty states (the hero and player stay cinematic), and adding a folder uses the EthOS folder picker. 1.0.0: first release. The Video Station desktop app moves out of the core install; the video library API, thumbnails and streaming stay in EthOS, shared with the Android app.
